start_channel.description: Channel number to tune to on startup. Must match a station's channel number. When set, it overrides 'recall last channel'.

recall_last_channel.description: Start on the last channel that was playing. When off, startup goes to the lowest numbered channel. Ignored when a start channel is set.

standby_image.description: Image shown while the player starts up, and on any station that doesn't set its own standby image. Relative paths are relative to the FieldStation42 folder.

time_format.description: strftime format for times on the cable box and on-screen displays, for example %H:%M or %I:%M %p.

date_time_format.description: strftime format for date and time values written to the status socket.

show_cable_box_time.description: Show the clock on the cable box display after it has been idle for a few seconds.

parental_controls_pin.description: Four-digit PIN required before a locked station will play. Stations opt in with 'parental controls' in their own settings.

parental_controls_theme.description: Look of the PIN prompt: classic (dark with yellow text), modern (dark with a blue accent) or minimal (light and plain).

schedule_agent.description: Extends schedules in the background before they run out. 'Extend when' is how close to running out a schedule can get; 'Extend by' is how much to add.

day_parts.description: Named periods of the day used by scheduling hints. Hours are 0-23. An end hour before the start hour wraps past midnight.

custom_holidays.description: Named recurring dates you can use as scheduling hints, for example 'December 25' or '4th thursday november'.

normalize_titles.description: Clean up titles parsed from filenames, removing things like episode numbers and release tags.

tmdb_api_key.description: API key for The Movie Database, used to look up metadata.

title_patterns.description: Extra regular expressions for pulling titles out of filenames. They are tried before the built-in ones. 'Group' is the capture group that holds the title.

api_key.description: Key required for the web console and the API. Changing it signs out every other browser, and scripts must be updated to send the new key.

overlay_conf.description: Look of the now-playing overlay drawn from NFO metadata.

server_host.description: Address the web server listens on. 0.0.0.0 means every network interface.

server_port.description: Port for the web server. Bookmarks and the remote control use this port too.

channel_socket.description: Socket file used to send channel changes to the player.

status_socket.description: File the player writes its now-playing status to.

db_path.description: Path to the catalog and schedule database.

start_mpv.description: Start mpv automatically with the player.

video_seek_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a video or stream to start before giving up.

follow_static_symlinks.description: Serve files through symlinks that point outside the static folders. Only turn this on if you control what those links point to.
